notes.title: Shot Online #4 Patch Note (2019.06.26)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/9f0dc9d39376a093aab3af91891a3d77d805f850.jpg[/img]


Hello Everyone!
Below are the details that have been updated through June Maintenance.



[h1][b]1. New Audhumbla Clubs[/b][/h1]
We have arrived with a new full set of clubs: Audhumbla. Check out the new design of the clubs and enjoy them in-game shortly!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/9f5fc1a9eadf75900429485091c204c8117cbd30.jpg[/img]



[h1][b]2. New Summer Clothes[/b][/h1]
New Summer Seasonal Clothes and a Special Contest Winning Set of Clothes have been added to the game! You will be able to enjoy the game with the seasonal Baseball themed clothes and Hot Summer Vibe themed special clothes shortly!

<Baseball Collection>
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/31fcddef483566a59aea396fb506b54be2773599.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/7688e0c22bb9b5811e13c37fc6477dbcc041fa27.jpg[/img]

<Summer Vibe Collection>
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/9026c7eb1f0ccca6918f22af33f41eaa322a0675.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/758b60f686bca4d928e55de2ca67df871dd30654.png[/img]



[h1][b]3. Additional Contents[/b][/h1]

[b]1) Dino Park Course added to Guild Agency[/b]
Guilds can now select Dino Park Course from the Guild Agency!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/b2510c65cd86d61bf05c588d5d09b24f8e57263f.jpg[/img]


[b]2) Missions and Holecount Events[/b]
Playing in World Travel Mode and Miniature Mode will also apply as participating in Mission events and Holecount events from now on.



[h1][b]4. Bugs Fixed[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Honor Pro users can now participate in Channel Tours
[*] New warning text has been added to the Character Name Change Ticket – The Swing Trainer buff will disappear if you use the ticket while having the buff active
[*] Game freezes when participating in Speed Matching with a 0 durability club equipped have been fixed
[*] Game freezes when the player pays the fee to enter the Graduation test have been fixed
[*] Guild Amity hat was not able to be equipped or taken off have been fixed
[*] Players are able to enter Hard Course Practice Mode through Caddies without any game crashes
[*] D~B Rank Guilds can apply for Channel Tours
[*] Client crashing when writing through the Megaphone item and hitting the Enter key twice have been fixed.
[*] Description has been edited for Lucky Boxes earned through Guild House benefits – The boxes will be distributed to the inventory instead of the Guild Locker.
[*] Additional Channel Tours can be opened while other Channel Tours are in progress.
[/olist]

We hope you will enjoy the new features!

Thank you for playing Shot Online Steam.


Best,
Shot Online Team

notes.title: Shot Online #3 Patch Note (2019.03.26)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/9f0dc9d39376a093aab3af91891a3d77d805f850.jpg[/img]

Hello Everyone!

We have arrived with new contents and features for Shot Online Steam!

[h1][b]1. Miniature Mode[/b][/h1]
We have added a new mode of round play: Miniature Mode! 

[u][b]How to Play[/b][/u]
1. Prepare the “Rufus Arena Miniature Ticket” item in your inventory
2. Create a room within the rounding list and use the “Rufus Arena Miniature Ticket” item. If you are playing with multiple players, only the Room Leader’s ticket is required.
3. After clicking Yes on the confirmation window, you will notice the change in the room design.
4. Enjoy Miniature Mode!

Since the Miniature Mode is a completely new content introduced to Shot Online, we will be providing Rufus Arena Miniature Tickets through events! Please check the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/390090/announcements/detail/1824428104739937948]Events Announcement[/url] for more details!

[u][b]Mode Detail[/b][/u]
[table]
     [tr]
         [th][b]Topic[/b][/th]
         [th][b]Limits[/b][/th]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]Level[/td]
         [td]No limit[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]Mulligan[/td]
         [td]Not Allowed[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]Mode[/td]
         [td]Miniature Mode[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]Number of Holes[/td]
         [td]3 hole game[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]Time[/td]
         [td]30 seconds[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]Shot[/td]
         [td]2[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]Max. Participation[/td]
         [td]10 times per week[/td]
     [/tr]
[/table] 

We will be adding more courses available for Miniature Mode in future updates.

[h1][b][IMPORTANT][/b][/h1]
If at least one of the co-players have reached their maximum 10 times per week limit, then the entire room cannot participate in Miniature Mode.
The count limit will be reset on Sunday 1AM

[u][b]Rewards[/b][/u]
You will be able to receive the Rufus Arena Miniature Pouch for every Birdie, and the Rufus Arena Miniature Present Box if you have completed all 3 holes!

[h1][b][IMPORTANT][/b][/h1]
Maximum 30 pouches can be obtained for each character
Maximum 10 boxes can be obtained per character per week
All contents within the Present Box and Pouch will last for 7 days.
All contents within the Present Box and Pouch are Character Bound.

[h1][b]2. Today’s Shot Online[/b][/h1]
Due to various contents provided within the game, we have prepared a contents guide so that players can easily see what game contents they can play for that day!

[u][b]How to use[/b][/u]
Click on the Guide icon that can be found under the Mini Map
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/484d12065a7b44c10ce73b0597cc9d47575d356a.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Contents[/b][/u]
The contents that you can see within the Guide are as followed:

[b]1. EVENT[/b]
You can see the current events within the game

[b]2. CONTENTS[/b]
You can see the list of contents that can be played for that day. You can also participate them directly from the window by clicking the blue Go button.

[b]3. Daily/Weekly Quests[/b]
You can see the list of available quests. You can easily access the Quest window by pressing the blue Open Quest button.

[h1][b]3. Character Bound Locker Expanded[/b][/h1]
The available number of slots for the Character Bound Locker has increased from 24 to 48 slots!

[h1][b]4. Club Reinforcement Ticket – Group 1 Discount[/b][/h1]
Through user’s feedback through the discussion board, we have decided to provide the Club Reinforcement Ticket – Group 1 item at a lower price! Starting from the end of the maintenance we will be lowering the amount the ingredients necessary for the Club Reinforcement Tickets. Also, we will be providing one extra ticket to users who have already crafted the tickets as well! 

We hope you will enjoy the new features!

Best,
Shot Online Team

notes.title: Shot Online #2 Patch Note (2019.02.27)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/9f0dc9d39376a093aab3af91891a3d77d805f850.jpg[/img]
Hello Everyone!

We have arrived with new contents and features for Shot Online Steam!

[b]1. New Sales items in the Item Mall[/b]
We have added new Club Package II, Clothing Package II, and Level Up Package II to the in-game Item Mall! More details regarding the package contents can be found through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/390090/announcements/detail/1817670802655645474]New Sales Announcement[/url].

[b]2. Additional Quests from Lv. 111 to 130[/b]
New quests have arrived for users who have already cleared every available quest on server! 
Users from Lv. 111 to 130 can enjoy the new quest contents. We apologize for the long wait.

[b]3. New Events Starting March[/b]
As we have closed the Guild Event, the Community Hub Event, and the Holecount Event, we have prepared new events for you to enjoy. More details regarding the new events can be seen through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/390090/announcements/detail/1817670802655639791]Event Announcement[/url]!

[b]4. Bugs Fixed[/b]
Through in-game reports and tests, we have discovered minor bugs and issues within the game. They have been taken into account and have been fixed!

We hope you will enjoy the new features!

Best,
Shot Online Team

notes.title: Shot Online #1 Patch Note (2019.01.31)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/abcbbd33f17d4edce7a02dd51e19fbb9d1b73a85.jpg[/img]
Hello Everyone! 

Around a week has passed since our grand launch on Steam! Through the in-game report system and the discussion board, we have collected feedback from players about the game, and arrived with a brief but crucial update.

[b]1. Server Time Change[/b]
Starting tomorrow, we will be changing the server time from PST to UTC. We will be hosting events and giving out rewards according to the standard UTC time, so don’t get confused with the changed standard server time!
**You will be able to check the server time by typing /time on the chat window in-game.

[h1][IMPORTANT][/h1]
For players who have bought the Gold Platinum Membership since the launching date, the membership duration already applied in UTC standard time. Since the Membership system was applied as UTC standard time, we have decided to change the server time to UTC as well. 

[b]2. Bugs fixed[/b]
Throughout the past week we have been receiving several reports and notices regarding incorrect or missing descriptions for quests and items. After reviewing the reported cases, we have fixed the errors. 

[b]3. New Items in the Item Recipe System[/b]
To encourage more players to use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1627013511]Item Recipe System[/url], we have added a new item: Zodiac Pin I 100. By using the Zodiac Pin I 100, players will get a boost of +1 for all stats for the next 100 holes played. This can be crafted by using ‘A fabric Piece’ you get during the rounding.

[b]4. New Caddie Package in the Item Mall[/b]
We have added a new sales item to the Item Mall: Caddie Package. You will be able to hire Caddies through purchasing the Caddie Package. For more details regarding the caddie system, please see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1640460579]Caddie Guide[/url].

We hope you will enjoy the new features!

Best,
Shot Online Team
